title: reliability: enforce SLOs, add circuit breakers, load shedding, regional failover + hotfix
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: Following incident SUP-314 we observed cascading failures when a regional model backend experienced increased p99 latency and errors. This PR implements a conservative, production-safe rollout of SLO enforcement, circuit breakers, priority-based load shedding, and regional failover logic, plus a small hotfix for an in-flight counter race that caused slow steady-state leak. Goals: reduce blast radius of backend regressions, preserve critical traffic under degraded conditions, and give operators clear knobs and observability. Changes include: 1) SLO Enforcer service: background worker that computes per-route latency/error SLOs (configurable windows) and emits alerts/metrics + exposes cg-controlled overrides. 2) Circuit breaker middleware: per-backend sliding-window counters with trip/retry logic and exponential backoff; exposes state to traces/metrics. 3) Load shedding: priority-aware token-bucket that applies soft shedding (fast-fail w/ Retry-After and structured diagnostic payload) and hard shedding when resources exhausted. 4) Regional failover: routing policy to failover to secondary region or compatible model variant when breakers trip or capacity low; respects data residency and tenant-level opt-outs. 5) Hotfix: fix off-by-one race in runtime/inflight_counter.go that could under-report in-flight requests when boundary conditions occur. 6) Observability: dashboards, SLO scorecards, and alert rules under observability-pack; added tracing tags for breaker decisions and shed reasons. 7) Feature flags & configs: feature_flags.slo_enforcer_enabled, circuit_breaker.window_ms, circuit_breaker.error_threshold, load_shedding.priority_threshold, regional_failover.enabled, plus operator CLI to override thresholds for emergency mitigation. Rollout plan: default flags disabled for 24 hours canary, enable for 5% traffic in region-us-west then gradual ramp with monitoring checks. Migration: adds slo_metrics table (lightweight TTLed rows) and a small schema migration script. Backwards compatibility: safe by default; breakers are permissive until enabled. Testing: unit tests for breaker logic, integration canary harness, load-shed simulator included. Related: Linear ENG-4721, ENG-4729, incident SUP-314. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration canary harness updated [x] dashboards and alerts added [x] migration script included [x] docs/console knobs documented. Notes: this PR intentionally keeps breaker defaults conservative to avoid customer-visible failures; operators should tune thresholds after canary.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial SLO enforcer worker and schema migration; circuit breaker middleware + tests; load shedding implementation + simulator; regional failover routing policy + docs; hotfix: fix in-flight counter race and add regression test

release_notes: Adds SLO Enforcer worker (configurable), circuit breaker middleware (per-backend sliding windows), priority-based load shedding with structured fast-fail payloads, regional failover routing policy, observability dashboards and alerts, migration script for slo_metrics, hotfix for in-flight counter race. Rollout: gated behind feature flag and staged canary.
rollback_plan: Feature flags can be turned off via operator CLI or Helm values; migration adds TTLed table so rolling back code is safe. In event of unexpected customer impact, disable feature_flags.slo_enforcer_enabled and circuit_breaker.enabled and revert routing policy; hotfix is small and safe to revert if needed.
notes: Operators: monitor slo_scorecard and the new slo_enforcer.alerts; default canary 24h -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% rollout cadence. ENG-4721 contains tuning guidance and historical incident timeline.
